items.text: Raymond Vergara is an insurance agent and the founder of RAV Insurance Services in Hawthorne. He has been a Farmers Insurance agent for 19 years. His campaign says he is running for City Treasurer because residents deserve clear answers about how their tax dollars are spent, and he wants to provide a line-by-line understanding of city spending.
